prompt:
Create premium square 1024x1024 full-bleed illustrated game key art, one cinematic
scene rather than a UI mockup. Keep the main character, face, and decisive prop
inside the central 60 percent. The bottom 20 percent contains only expendable
atmosphere because store controls may cover it. Reserve the upper 22 percent as
a broad, calm, uniform field of atmospheric color for later graphic design.
Deliver a pure textless story illustration with a clean uninterrupted silhouette.
 A lone elegant white-suited aerial ink performer floats in a vast charcoal
 cubic warehouse,
 bracing a small white circular color cannon as its recoil pushes the body
 backward. Four walls are struck by vivid cyan, orchid, blush and acid-lime
 abstract paint explosions, with frozen droplets forming a dramatic
 four-direction composition. Editorial screen-print texture, sophisticated dark
 negative space, visceral recoil, one bright central figure, unmistakable action.

composition.title: RECOIL BLOOM
composition.method: Pillow raster typography over Aigram-generated raster art
